scenarios.name: black-mana-unavailable-without-swamp-or-forest
scenarios.why: The black-producing ability requires control of a Swamp or Forest; the Verge alone has neither subtype.

scenarios.name: black-mana-offered-with-swamp
scenarios.why: Controlling a Swamp satisfies the stated land-type condition, making the black-producing ability available.

scenarios.name: black-mana-activates-with-forest
scenarios.why: A Forest meets the subtype condition. Activating the available mana ability taps the Verge and adds black mana.
